name: Hexing Squelcher
oracle_text:
This spell can't be countered.
Ward—Pay 2 life.
Spells you control can't be countered.
Other creatures you control have "Ward—Pay 2 life."
blocked_sentences: Spells you control can't be countered.

needs.what: a static ability on a permanent that makes *other* spells uncounterable -- a `cant_be_countered` static whose filter picks the spells it protects (here every spell its controller controls), consulted by the `counter` op against the stack item's controller and characteristics rather than against the casting card's own printed flag, so that a spell cast after this creature is already on the battlefield survives being countered
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The engine's only uncounterable-ness is the card-level `uncounterable` boolean (src/commanderblitz/cards/schema.py:577 -> src/commanderblitz/engine/carddef.py:747), which the `counter` op reads straight off the spell's own registry definition (src/commanderblitz/engine/effects/ops_stack.py:253) -- it is a printed property of one card, so it can say line 1 ("This spell can't be countered") and nothing more; it cannot be granted, and there is no filter or controller on it. Nothing in `static_effects` reaches the stack at all: `ward` and `protection` are the closest, and both tax or forbid *targeting* a permanent while leaving countering untouched, and `spell_cost_reduction` is the only static that looks at spells and it only changes their price. As docs/card-dsl-cookbook.md, "Target opponent and up to one target creature they control" says outright, statics do not reach a spell on the stack, so this needs new plumbing in the `counter` op, not a new card field.
